claims.statement: At 200°C on Pt/CeO2, the rate of 12C-formate exchange during SSITKA is 5 to 10 times slower than the overall steady-state turnover frequency of CO2 production.
claims.source_citation: C. M. Kalamaras et al., J. Catal. 279 (2011) 287-300

claims.statement: Transient isotopic pulsing of C16O over H218O-treated Pt/CeO2 at 200°C initially yields over 85% C16O2 rather than C16O18O, confirming direct participation of support lattice oxygen.
claims.source_citation: C. M. Kalamaras et al., J. Catal. 279 (2011) 287-300

claims.statement: In situ DRIFTS during steady-state WGS reaction shows persistent, intense surface formate bands at 1572 cm^-1, 1370 cm^-1, and 2845 cm^-1.
claims.source_citation: F. C. Meunier et al., J. Catal. 252 (2007) 18-22

claims.statement: Steady-state kinetic isotope effect (KIE = r_H / r_D) on Pt/CeO2 between H2O and D2O is measured at 1.15 to 1.30 across 180°C to 240°C.
claims.source_citation: R. Burch, Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 8 (2006) 5483-5494

claims.statement: Operando XAS at the Ce L3 edge reveals dynamic reversible Ce3+ reduction fractions between 6% and 12% at the Pt-ceria interface during active WGS catalysis.
claims.source_citation: J. A. Rodriguez et al., Science 318 (2007) 1757-1760

claims.statement: Density functional theory (DFT+U) calculations indicate carboxyl (*COOH) formation barrier (0.58 eV) is significantly lower than the uncatalyzed formate decomposition barrier (1.42 eV).
claims.source_citation: C. M. Kalamaras et al., J. Catal. 264 (2009) 117-129

claims.statement: Authors hypothesize that observed formates reside primarily on spectator ceria support sites away from the Pt active perimeter.
claims.source_citation: F. C. Meunier et al., J. Catal. 252 (2007) 18-22
